```{r load sample info}
samples <- read.csv("data/annotations/sample_id_map.csv", header = TRUE)

samples$tsv_file_name <- gsub(".bam", ".combined_counts.tsv", samples$file_name)
samples$tsv_file_name <- gsub("-", "\\.", samples$tsv_file_name)

length(unique(samples$tsv_file_name))

# remove duplicate sample files, keeping the resequenced version where applicable
removed <- c("TCGA-B2-3923-01A-02R-A277-07",
             "TCGA-B2-3923-01B-10R-A277-07",
             "TCGA-B2-3924-01A-02R-A277-07",
             "TCGA-B2-5633-01A-01R-A277-07",
             "TCGA-B2-5635-01A-01R-A277-07",
             "TCGA-DV-A4W0-05A-11R-A266-07")
which(samples$entity_submitter_id %in% removed)
removed <- c(44, 111, 458, 471, 508, 550)
removed_files <- samples[removed, ]
samples <- samples[-removed, ]

samples$samples <- gsub(" ", "_", samples$samples)

samples <- samples %>%
  mutate(abv_id = str_extract(entity_submitter_id, "TCGA-\\w+-\\w+")) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_extract(entity_submitter_id, "TCGA-\\w+-\\w+-\\d+\\w"))
```

```{r format counts -- SKIP}
# Read in per-sample counts files and merge into a single matrix;
# features absent from a given sample are assigned 0 counts
files <- list.files("data/counts/", pattern = "*.tsv", full.names = TRUE)
names(files) <- basename(files)
data_list <- lapply(files, read.table, header = TRUE)
merged_data <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "feature_id", all = TRUE), data_list)
colnames(merged_data) <- c("feature_id", names(data_list))
merged_data[is.na(merged_data)] <- 0
merged_data <- merged_data %>% dplyr::filter(!str_detect(feature_id, "^_"))

remove_cols <- which(str_extract(colnames(merged_data), "^.*.rna") %in% str_extract(removed_files$file_name, "^.*.rna"))
merged_data <- merged_data[, -remove_cols]

row.names(merged_data) <- merged_data$feature_id
merged_data <- merged_data[, -1]

samples$tsv_file_name[which(samples$tsv_file_name %notin% colnames(merged_data))]

colnames(merged_data) <- gsub("-", "\\.", colnames(merged_data))
samples <- samples[match(colnames(merged_data), samples$tsv_file_name), ]
colnames(merged_data) <- samples$sample_id

#write.csv(merged_data, "data/counts_merged.csv", quote = F)
```

```{r DESEQ2}
counts <- read.csv("data/counts_merged.csv", row.names = 1)
colnames(counts) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(counts))
samples <- samples[match(colnames(counts), samples$sample_id), ]

sampleTable <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(samples$samples),
  abv_id = factor(samples$abv_id),
  sample_id = factor(samples$sample_id)
)

colnames(counts) <- sampleTable$sample_id
rownames(sampleTable) <- sampleTable$sample_id

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts,
                                colData = sampleTable,
                                design = ~ condition)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r PCA}
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = c("condition")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#00BFC4", "#F8766D")) +
  ggtitle("TCGA-KIRC PCA") +
  theme_classic()

#ggsave("output/tcga_kirc_pca.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)
```

```{r run contrasts}
res_TvsN <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "Solid_Tissue_Normal", "Primary_Tumor"))
res_TvsN <- res_TvsN[complete.cases(res_TvsN), ]
result_TvsN <- res_TvsN[order(res_TvsN$padj), ]

all_res <- data.frame(result_TvsN) %>% filter(str_detect(rownames(.), "RBRT"))

DEH <- data.frame(result_TvsN[which(abs(result_TvsN$log2FoldChange) > 1 & result_TvsN$padj < 0.05), ])
#write.csv(DEH, "output/tcga_kirc_degs.csv", row.names = T, quote = F)
DEH <- DEH %>%
  filter(str_detect(rownames(DEH), "RBRT")) %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange <= -1) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange, desc(baseMean)) %>%
  mutate(idx = row.names(.))

annot <- read.table("data/annotations/hervs_v13_to_v6_compare.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
#write.csv(DEH, "output/tcga_kirc_deh.csv", quote = F)
```

```{r compare}
# compare TCGA-derived DE HERVs against the independent patient cohort
n8 <- read.csv("data/results/patients_deh_results.csv")

shared <- DEH[DEH$idx %in% n8$idx, ]

hervdb <- read.table("data/annotations/hervs_8k.gtf", sep = "\t") %>%
  mutate(family = str_extract(V9, "gene_id .*; tr")) %>%
  dplyr::select(V2, family)

hervdb$family <- gsub("gene_id RBRT\\d+-", "", hervdb$family)
hervdb$family <- gsub("; tr", "", hervdb$family)
colnames(hervdb)[1] <- "idx"

shared <- left_join(shared, hervdb)
#write.csv(shared, "output/shared_deh.csv", quote = F)
table(shared$family)

hervs_8k <- read.table("data/annotations/hervs_nsltr_corr_8k.tsv", header = TRUE)
```

```{r MA plot}
gene_names <- DEH %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% arrange(desc(baseMean), log2FoldChange)
gene_names <- as.vector(row.names(gene_names))
gene_names <- gene_names[1:15]

length(which(all_res$log2FoldChange >= 1))
length(which(all_res$log2FoldChange <= -1))

ggmaplot(all_res, main = "MA plot of TCGA-KIRC tumor vs normal DE HERVs",
   fdr = 0.05, fc = 2, size = 0.4,
   palette = c("#B31B21", "#1465AC", "darkgray"),
   label.select = gene_names,
   legend = "top", top = 0,
   font.label = c("bold", 11),
   font.legend = "bold",
   font.main = "bold",
   ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_minimal())

#ggsave("output/tcga_ma_de_herv.pdf", width = 5, height = 5)
```

```{r heatmap but apply FC and expression filter}
# expression threshold per Telescope paper: CPM 0.5 x 10 samples
cpm <- cpm(counts)

sub_cpm <- filter(as.data.frame(cpm), row.names(cpm) %in% row.names(DEH))

annotation <- sampleTable %>% select(condition)
annotation <- annotation %>% arrange(factor(row.names(annotation), levels = colnames(sub_cpm)))

# expression filter based on tumor samples only
tumor <- annotation %>% filter(condition == "Primary_Tumor")
tumor_exp <- as.data.frame(sub_cpm) %>% dplyr::select(row.names(tumor))
rown <- row.names(tumor_exp)
tumor_exp <- tumor_exp %>%
  mutate(idx = row.names(tumor_exp)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(med = median(c_across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(ave = mean(c_across(where(is.numeric)), na.rm = TRUE))
row.names(tumor_exp) <- rown

# select loci with highest fold change and highest median tumor expression
tumor_exp <- merge(tumor_exp, DEH, by = "idx")
tumor_exp <- tumor_exp %>% arrange(desc(med), log2FoldChange)

top25 <- tumor_exp$idx[1:15]

hi_fc_exp <- filter(as.data.frame(cpm), row.names(cpm) %in% top25)

ann_colors <- list(condition = c(Primary_Tumor = "cyan1", Solid_Tissue_Normal = "coral1"))
mat_breaks <- c(0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 20)

main <- "high exp, hi FC DE Tumor up hervs -- CPM, manual breaks, median exp"

pheatmap(hi_fc_exp,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         clustering_method = "mcquitty",
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         breaks = mat_breaks,
         color = inferno(length(mat_breaks) - 1),
         main = main,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         annotation = annotation,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         border_color = NA,
         legend = TRUE, annotation_legend = FALSE)
#ggsave("output/tcga_hi_exp_fc_filt_de_hervs_hm.pdf", width = 8.5, height = 8.5)
```

```{r barplots}
cpm <- cpm(counts)

hoi <- c("RBRT304117", "RBRT162940", "RBRT190212", "RBRT11613", "RBRT424674", "RBRT442033")

cpm <- as.data.frame(cpm) %>% filter(row.names(cpm) %in% hoi)
cpm <- t(cpm)
row.names(sampleTable) <- sampleTable$sample_id
cpm <- merge(cpm, sampleTable, by = "row.names")

cpm <- gather(as.data.frame(cpm), key = "herv", value = "value", c(RBRT11613:RBRT442033))
my_comparisons <- list(c("normal", "tumor"))

summary_data <- cpm %>%
  group_by(condition, herv) %>%
  summarise(mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_value = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE))

stats_results <- cpm %>%
  group_by(herv) %>%
  t_test(value ~ condition) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "none") %>%
  add_significance("p") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "condition", scales = "free_y", step.increase = 0.25)

gg_list <- list()
for (i in unique(cpm$herv)) {
  data <- cpm[which(cpm$herv[] == i), ]
  summary_sub <- summary_data[which(summary_data$herv == i), ]
  stats_sub <- stats_results[which(stats_results$herv == i), ]
  gg_list[[i]] <- ggplot(data, aes(x = condition, y = value, group = condition)) +
    labs(title = paste(i)) +
    theme_classic() +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = condition)) +
    geom_point() +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 10), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    ylab("CPM") +
    geom_errorbar(data = summary_sub,
                  aes(x = condition, y = mean_value,
                      ymin = mean_value - sd_value,
                      ymax = mean_value + sd_value, group = condition),
                  width = 0.2,
                  color = "black") +
    stat_pvalue_manual(stats_sub,
                        label = "p.signif",
                        tip.length = 0.01,
                        size = 3,
                        hide.ns = FALSE)

  print(gg_list[[i]])
  #ggsave(filename = paste0("output/cpm_", i, ".pdf"), width = 6, height = 6)
}
```

# plotting HERV-E elements in general 
```{r}
hervdb <- read.table("data/annotations/hervs_8k.gtf", sep = "\t") %>%
  mutate(family = str_extract(V9, "gene_id .*; tr")) %>%
  dplyr::select(V2, family)

hervdb$family <- gsub("gene_id RBRT\\d+-", "", hervdb$family)
hervdb$family <- gsub("; tr", "", hervdb$family)
colnames(hervdb)[1] <- "idx"
hervdb$family <- gsub("Clade \\w+,.*", "complex_mosaic", hervdb$family)
hervdb$family <- gsub(".*\\|.*", "unresolved_mosaic", hervdb$family)

herve <- hervdb %>% filter(family == "HERV-E")

cpm <- cpm(counts)
hoi <- herve$idx
sub_cpm <- filter(as.data.frame(cpm), row.names(cpm) %in% hoi) %>% filter(rowSums(.) > 10)

ann_colors <- list(condition = c(Primary_Tumor = "cyan1", Solid_Tissue_Normal = "coral1"))
mat_breaks <- c(0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 20)

main <- "TCGA-KIRC: HERVs of interest"

pheatmap(sub_cpm,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         clustering_method = "mcquitty",
         clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
         breaks = mat_breaks,
         color = inferno(length(mat_breaks) - 1),
         main = main,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = FALSE,
         clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
         annotation = annotation,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         border_color = NA,
         legend = TRUE, annotation_legend = FALSE)
```

```{r which families do the DE HERVs that are up in normal belong to?}
hervdb <- read.table("data/annotations/hervs_8k.gtf", sep = "\t") %>%
  mutate(family = str_extract(V9, "gene_id .*; tr")) %>%
  dplyr::select(V2, family)

hervdb$family <- gsub("gene_id RBRT\\d+-", "", hervdb$family)
hervdb$family <- gsub("; tr", "", hervdb$family)
colnames(hervdb)[1] <- "idx"
hervdb$family <- gsub("Clade \\w+,.*", "complex_mosaic", hervdb$family)
hervdb$family <- gsub(".*\\|.*", "unresolved_mosaic", hervdb$family)

up_norm <- all_res %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange >= 1 & padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(idx = str_extract(row.names(.), "RBRT\\d+"))

up_norm <- left_join(up_norm, hervdb) %>% group_by(family) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% arrange(desc(n))

up_tumor <- all_res %>%
  filter(log2FoldChange <= -1 & padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(idx = str_extract(row.names(.), "RBRT\\d+"))

up_tumor <- left_join(up_tumor, hervdb) %>% group_by(family) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% arrange(desc(n))
```

### Stratifying by clinical covariates
1) Stage
2) Age

```{r load clin data}
counts <- read.csv("data/counts_merged.csv", row.names = 1)
colnames(counts) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(counts))

tumors <- samples %>% filter(samples == "Primary_Tumor")
counts_tumor <- counts %>% dplyr::select(which(colnames(counts) %in% tumors$sample_id))

clindata <- read.csv("data/clinical/tcga_kirc_clinical_metadata.csv")
length(unique(samples$case_id))

meta <- merge(tumors, clindata, by = "case_id")

sampleTable <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(meta$samples),
  ptid = factor(meta$abv_id),
  stage = factor(meta$ajcc_pathologic_stage)
)

table(sampleTable$stage)
table(meta$age_at_index)
table(meta$gender)
table(meta$race)

rownames(sampleTable) <- meta$sample_id
sampleTable <- sampleTable[match(colnames(counts_tumor), row.names(sampleTable)), ]

sampleTable <- na.omit(sampleTable)
counts_tumor <- counts_tumor %>% dplyr::select(which(colnames(counts_tumor) %in% row.names(sampleTable)))

#write.csv(sampleTable, "output/tcga_stage_metadata.csv", quote = F)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts_tumor,
                                colData = sampleTable,
                                design = ~ stage)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r stratifying by clinical covariates - Stage I v Stage II}
res_stg_IvII <- results(dds, contrast = c("stage", "Stage I", "Stage II"))
summary(res_stg_IvII)
res_stg_IvII <- res_stg_IvII[complete.cases(res_stg_IvII), ]
result_stg_IvII <- res_stg_IvII[order(res_stg_IvII$padj), ]

stg_IvIIDEG <- data.frame(result_stg_IvII[which(abs(result_stg_IvII$log2FoldChange) > 2 & result_stg_IvII$padj < 0.05), ])
row.names(stg_IvIIDEG) <- gsub("::.*", "", row.names(stg_IvIIDEG))
stg_IvIIDEG <- stg_IvIIDEG %>%
  filter(str_detect(rownames(stg_IvIIDEG), "RBRT")) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange, desc(baseMean)) %>%
  mutate(IDm = row.names(.)) %>%
  mutate(stg = "Stage III")
nrow(stg_IvIIDEG)
```

```{r combine all stage specific hervs and plot}
stage_hervs <- c(stg_IvIIDEG$IDm, stg_IvIIIDEG$IDm, stg_IvIVDEG$IDm,
                  stg_IIvIIIDEG$IDm, stg_IIvIVDEG$IDm, stg_IIIvIVDEG$IDm) %>% unique()

cpm_tumor <- cpm(counts_tumor)
cpm_tumor <- as.data.frame(cpm_tumor) %>% filter(row.names(.) %in% stage_hervs)
cpm_tumor <- t(cpm_tumor)

cpm_tumor <- merge(cpm_tumor, sampleTable, by = "row.names")
row.names(cpm_tumor) <- cpm_tumor$Row.names
cpm_tumor <- cpm_tumor[, -1]

cpm_tumor <- pivot_longer(cpm_tumor, cols = where(is.numeric))

summary_df <- cpm_tumor |>
  group_by(stage, name) |>
  summarise(mean_expr = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = stage, y = mean_expr, group = name, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Stage", y = "Mean Expression", color = "Element") +
  ggtitle("DE HERVs between stages")

#ggsave(filename = "output/tcga_de_stage_hervs.pdf", width = 11, height = 8)

# color by family instead of individual locus
colnames(hervdb)[1] <- "name"
summary_df <- left_join(summary_df, hervdb)
summary_df$family <- gsub("Clade I.*", "Clade I", summary_df$family)

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = stage, y = mean_expr, group = family, color = family)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Stage", y = "Mean Expression", color = "Element") +
  ggtitle("DE HERVs between stages")

#ggsave(filename = "output/tcga_de_stage_hervs_fam.pdf", width = 11, height = 8)
```

# by age

```{r age}
counts <- read.csv("data/counts_merged.csv", row.names = 1)
colnames(counts) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(counts))

tumors <- samples %>% filter(samples == "Primary_Tumor")
counts_tumor <- counts %>% dplyr::select(which(colnames(counts) %in% tumors$sample_id))

clindata <- read.csv("data/clinical/tcga_kirc_clinical_metadata.csv")
meta <- merge(tumors, clindata, by = "case_id")

sampleTable <- data.frame(
  condition = factor(meta$samples),
  ptid = factor(meta$abv_id),
  age = as.numeric(meta$age_at_index)
)

sampleTable <- sampleTable |>
  mutate(age_group = cut(age,
                         breaks = c(26, 40, 55, 70, 90),
                         labels = c("26-40", "41-55", "56-70", "71-90"),
                         include.lowest = TRUE))

rownames(sampleTable) <- meta$sample_id
sampleTable <- sampleTable[match(colnames(counts_tumor), row.names(sampleTable)), ]

sampleTable <- na.omit(sampleTable)
counts_tumor <- counts_tumor %>% dplyr::select(which(colnames(counts_tumor) %in% row.names(sampleTable)))

#write.csv(sampleTable, "output/tcga_age_metadata.csv", quote = F)

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts_tumor,
                                colData = sampleTable,
                                design = ~ age_group)

dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

```{r stratifying by clinical covariates - age groups 26-40 vs 41-55}
res_age_1v2 <- results(dds, contrast = c("age_group", "26-40", "41-55"))
summary(res_age_1v2)
res_age_1v2 <- res_age_1v2[complete.cases(res_age_1v2), ]
result_age_1v2 <- res_age_1v2[order(res_age_1v2$padj), ]

age_1v2DEG <- data.frame(result_age_1v2[which(abs(result_age_1v2$log2FoldChange) > 1 & result_age_1v2$padj < 0.05), ])
row.names(age_1v2DEG) <- gsub("::.*", "", row.names(age_1v2DEG))
age_1v2DEG <- age_1v2DEG %>%
  filter(str_detect(rownames(age_1v2DEG), "RBRT")) %>%
  arrange(log2FoldChange, desc(baseMean)) %>%
  mutate(IDm = row.names(.)) %>%
  mutate(stg = "Stage III")
nrow(age_1v2DEG)
```

```{r combine all age specific hervs and plot}
summary_df <- cpm_tumor |>
  group_by(age_group, name) |>
  summarise(mean_expr = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = age_group, y = mean_expr, group = name, color = name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  labs(x = "Stage", y = "Mean Expression", color = "Element") +
  ggtitle("DE HERVs between age groups")

summary_df$family <- gsub("Clade I.*", "Clade I", summary_df$family)
```

```{r DE HERV family distribution normalized}
hervdb <- read.table("data/annotations/hervs_8k.gtf", sep = "\t") %>%
  mutate(family = str_extract(V9, "gene_id .*; tr")) %>%
  dplyr::select(V2, family)

hervdb$family <- gsub("gene_id RBRT\\d+-", "", hervdb$family)
hervdb$family <- gsub("; tr", "", hervdb$family)
colnames(hervdb)[1] <- "idx"
hervdb$family <- gsub("Clade \\w+,.*", "complex_mosaic", hervdb$family)
hervdb$family <- gsub(".*\\|.*", "unresolved_mosaic", hervdb$family)

all_de <- c(de_pts$idx, de_tcga$idx) %>% unique()
all_de <- hervdb %>% filter(idx %in% all_de) %>% group_by(family) %>% summarize(n = n())

family_norm <- hervdb %>% group_by(family) %>% summarize(n_fam = n())

all_de <- left_join(all_de, family_norm, by = "family") %>%
  mutate(norm = n / n_fam * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(norm))

library(PNWColors)
pal <- pnw_palette("Starfish", 45)

ggplot(all_de, aes(x = reorder(str_trunc(family, 25), desc(norm)), y = norm, fill = family)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("family") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = .95, angle = 45), legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("DE HERV families") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal)

#ggsave("output/de_hervs_by_fam_norm.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

# shared DE loci only
shared_de <- de_pts$idx[which(de_pts$idx %in% de_tcga$idx)] %>% unique()
shared_de <- hervdb %>% filter(idx %in% shared_de) %>% group_by(family) %>% summarize(n = n())

family_norm <- hervdb %>% group_by(family) %>% summarize(n_fam = n())
shared_de <- left_join(shared_de, family_norm, by = "family") %>%
  mutate(norm = n / n_fam * 100) %>%
  arrange(desc(norm))

pal <- pnw_palette("Starfish", 9)
shared_de$family[7] <- "other"

ggplot(shared_de, aes(x = reorder(str_trunc(family, 25), desc(norm)), y = norm, fill = family)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("family") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = .95, angle = 45, size = 15), legend.position = "none") +
  ggtitle("Shared DE HERV families (TCGA + patient cohort)") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal)

#ggsave("output/sharedde_hervs_by_fam_norm.pdf", width = 8, height = 8)

```

```{r which HERV hits are in retrotector}
de_pts <- read.csv("data/results/patients_deh_results.csv")
de_tcga <- read.csv("data/results/tcga_kirc_deh.csv")

all_de <- rbind(de_pts, de_tcga) %>% group_by(idx) %>% summarize(lfc = -1 * mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE))
shared_de <- de_pts$idx[which(de_pts$idx %in% de_tcga$idx)] %>% unique()

hervdb_annot <- read.table("data/annotations/hervs_nsltr_8k.tsv", sep = "\t", header = TRUE)
hervdb_annot <- hervdb_annot %>% mutate(annotation = str_extract(idxRBT, "T")) %>% select(idx, annotation)
hervdb_annot$annotation[which(is.na(hervdb_annot$annotation))] <- "HERVdb"
hervdb_annot$annotation <- gsub("T", "HERVdb + retrotector", hervdb_annot$annotation)

all_de <- left_join(all_de, hervdb_annot)
all_de$lfc <- round(all_de$lfc)

pal <- pnw_palette("Starfish", 4)
ggplot(all_de, aes(x = factor(lfc), fill = annotation)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "count", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("log2FC") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = .95, angle = 45)) +
  ggtitle("DE HERVs from each annotation") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal)

#ggsave("output/de_hervs_from_annot.pdf", width = 6, height = 6)

shared_de <- all_de %>% filter(idx %in% shared_de)
ggplot(shared_de, aes(x = factor(lfc), fill = retrotector)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "count", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("log2FC") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = .95, angle = 45)) +
  ggtitle("DE HERVs from each annotation") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal)

#ggsave("output/de_hervs_from_annot_shared.pdf", width = 6, height = 8)

pal <- pnw_palette("Starfish", 50)
all_de_fam <- left_join(all_de, hervdb) %>% group_by(retrotector)
ggplot(all_de_fam, aes(x = factor(lfc), fill = family)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "count", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("log2FC") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 1, vjust = .95, angle = 45)) +
  ggtitle("DE HERVs from each annotation") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal)
```

```{r for shared DE HERVs, what viral genes}
de_gtf <- read.table("data/annotations/hervs_8k_v13.gtf", sep = "\t") %>%
  mutate(idx = str_extract(V9, "RBRT\\d+"))

de_gtf <- de_gtf %>% filter(idx %in% shared_de) %>% dplyr::select(-idx)

#write.table(de_gtf, "output/de_herv.gtf", sep = "\t", row.names = F, quote = F)

# intersect results, filtering out gene/transcript-level entries
int <- read.table("data/annotations/de_herv_intersect_genes.bed", sep = "\t") %>%
  mutate(idx = str_extract(V9, "RBRT\\d+")) %>%
  filter(V11 != "HERVdb")

genes <- c("gag", "pro", "pol", "env", "ltr", "rt", "tm", "su", "ltr\\d+")
pattern <- paste0("\\b(", paste(genes, collapse = "|"), ")\\b")

viral <- int |>
  mutate(gene_name = toupper(str_extract(V18, regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))))
viral$gene_name <- gsub("LTR\\d+", "LTR", viral$gene_name)

viral_sum <- viral %>% group_by(gene_name) %>% summarize(n = n()) %>% arrange(desc(n))

library(PNWColors)
pal <- pnw_palette("Sailboat", 10)

ggplot(viral_sum, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = gene_name)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(gene_name, ": ", n)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3.5, color = "black", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  labs(title = "viral genes of shared DE HERVs",
       x = NULL, y = "count", fill = "gene") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

#ggsave("output/shared_de_herv_viral_genes.pdf", height = 8, width = 6)
```
